description: WEA-Acceptance-Data publishes one month of combined wind-turbine operating, meteorological and acoustic observations. The Leibniz University Hannover repository provides version 2.0, including conditioned and anonymised measurements, metadata, documentation and three worked use cases. Acoustic products include ten-minute sound-pressure and third-octave summaries as well as audio records. CSV and JSON metadata or tables and ZIP bundles are freely accessible under CC BY-NC 3.0. The site-specific records can calibrate coupled turbine-noise and atmospheric-propagation simulations under different operating conditions. Coverage is limited by anonymisation, removed erroneous values and marked outliers, which affect interpretation, and further campaigns require contact with the authors. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
